# London Furnace Repair

> London Furnace Repair is a licensed, insured heating and HVAC company in London, Ontario that specializes in furnace repair, installation, and 24/7 no-heat emergencies across London and Middlesex County. Heating is our focus, and we also handle cooling, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 709-3822
Email: contact@londonfurnacerepair.ca
Service area: London, Ontario and Middlesex County (including St. Thomas, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka)
